t: Miss Me A Little When Im Gone
d: Malik gets into a confrontation with his ex-girlfriend's current man, and must choose between her and his current flame. Meanwhile, Blue and Keira have a revealing moment after an argument about how honest their relationship is.

Tasha seeks out counseling from a professional to determine where her datingproblems come from. Eventually Malik stops by, making it a group session with the mother and son duo discovering certain truths about themselves.
For Kim, Nikki and their friends, Halloween becomes a fright night to remember.
Nikki must find a way to sell 6,000 cookies.
Nikki suspects her new boss is actually a Mob boss.
A game show appearance reveals a startling Parkers family secret.
Everyone learns the true meaning of Christmas after getting locked inside a department store.
Professor Oglevee teaches his class a history lesson in honor of Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr.'s birthday.
Hazel scrambles when Regina goes missing right before the Grammys, David takes a big step forward, and Bree and Gary turn a luxury purchase into a new family adventure.

A public breakup with her cheating music producer husband has singing superstar Hazel turning to her BFFs Ari and Bree for support. Feeling unfulfilled, the women vow to reclaim their lives, starting by releasing Hazel's new song themselves.

A spending spree with Derek's money gets Hazel financially cut off. Ari agrees to be Hazel's lawyer and is put in an awkward position when David accepts a donation from Derek. After trying therapy with Gary, Bree realizes she wants a divorce.

Ari and David clash about Derek's growing involvement in David's campaign. Unable to track down Hazel's pre-nup, Ari, Hazel, and Bree orchestrate a heist into Derek's penthouse to steal his copy of their pre-nup. Bree serves Gary with divorce papers.

When Charmaine informs Tasha and Jamal that their new home was the scene of a triple homicide, they move in with Charles and Stacy. Crystal decides to lose her virginity to Rashad. Troy takes Kita on a romantic getaway.
